summary: The review passes under the PM round cap. The review found no real-key leak in the audited changes. The weekly update still has correctness defects.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Nit] review-a: A flagless run with the stable record writes and commits docs. update.sh:49-80 checks the flag only for the missing-record refusal. At line 179, the record alone selects the docs branch. update.test.ts:281-285 and 322-354 reproduce the unwanted commit. update-approval.test.ts:284-298 tests only a missing record. Route one fix round: make the flag select the branch and test both record states. score-impact: no.

F2 [Nit] review-a: A changed incomplete score file leaves stale pass counts and scores on review.html. update.sh:135-160 tests route completeness, not a score change. The same test selects an unchanged complete file. update-pages.test.ts:163-188 copies the tracked score into the nominal no-score fixture; P2a checks path inclusion, not exact equality or the rendered score. Route one fix round: compare the consumed score with the published baseline and pin changed incomplete and unchanged complete cases. score-impact: yes.

F3 [Nit] review-a: The leak check scans unrelated files and can refuse a clean weekly commit. update.sh:228-248 scans the repo and the whole preview before it defines COMMIT_PATHS. leak-check.ts:237-253 scans the index, all docs, and all preview files. L1, L2, and L4 require refusals for paths outside the commit. Route one fix round: scan exactly the candidate files and test both a candidate hit and an unrelated hit. score-impact: no.

F4 [Nit] review-a: The weekly scan uses .tmp/model-guide-private instead of the private location in measure/archive/model_guide/test-strategy.md:1804. leak-check.ts:115-118 silently finds no seeded lines when the directory is absent. The scanner also does not check the credential shapes named in spec.md:71-72. The review found no real-key exposure. Route one fix round for the wrong scan input. Track the scanner's credential-shape gap as tech debt. score-impact: no.

F5 [Nit] review-a: A render failure leaves the new JSON beside the old HTML in docs. update.sh:186-199 copies both data files before preview.sh can refuse. update.sh:218-240 also copies pages before the leak check can refuse. Route one fix round: validate the complete candidate set before changing docs. Pin a renderer refusal and a leak refusal. score-impact: yes.

F6 [Nit] review-a: The plan's FR-1 to FR-5 claim at plan.md:134 is broader than the tests prove. The P4 callback passes with an in-memory no-op fixture; P1 rejects a missing page. L1-L4 never plant a hit in a candidate file or use a private fixture. Record the limited proof in the plan and track independent test gaps as tech debt. score-impact: no.
